extracted.name: Spinach Mushroom Omelet
extracted.description: This mushroom omelet is a hearty but healthy way to start your day, with mostly egg whites, fresh spinach, bell peppers, tomato, and two kinds of cheese.
ingredient_lines: 2 tablespoons finely chopped red bell pepper
instruction_lines: Whisk egg whites and egg together in a small bowl. Mix in Parmesan, Cheddar, salt, red pepper flakes, garlic powder, nutmeg, and pepper.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Sauté mushrooms, green onions, and bell pepper until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add spinach and cook until just wilted, 1 to 2 minutes. Stir in tomato, then pour in egg mixture. As egg mixture starts to set, lift the edges and let the uncooked portion flow underneath.
Cook until egg mixture sets, 10 to 15 minutes. Cut into wedges and serve immediately.
